title: SCPN MIF Liner Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the mechanical/liquid-liner magnetised-target fusion configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the mass, kinetic energy, drive pressure and characteristic time of a driven annular liner, and ideal flux and adiabatic compression recorded as upper bounds), and tessellated and B-rep models of the liner, its coaxial return conductor and end electrodes. Parameter sets are synthetic or anchored on a filed design study; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
